people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
translations.bsb: He also put shields and spears in all the cities and strengthened them greatly. So Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
translations.kjv: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
translations.asv: And in every city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong. And Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
